name: sutra-studio
description: Build, inspect, validate, debug, responsively verify, and normalize canonical React UI documents in Sutra Studio from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Build React interfaces in the desktop Studio
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a running Sutra Studio app through a private authenticated bridge, then use compact versioned tools to inspect hierarchy and component manifests, apply atomic UI operations, normalize repeated siblings into typed React Repeat/map structures, inspect generated TSX contracts, add breakpoint-aware styles, validate the canonical AST, inspect rendered geometry across viewports, and capture clean PNG previews for screenshot fidelity.
capabilities: Normalize repeated UI into typed React maps
defaultPrompt: Recreate this design in the running Sutra Studio app and verify it at the source image dimensions.
Analyze repeated siblings, convert the reviewed candidates to typed Repeat nodes, and verify generated React output.
Make the active page responsive without duplicating its component tree, then check mobile, tablet, desktop, and wide layouts.
Inspect the current Sutra page and fix its layout diagnostics.
Add a typed page prop and bind it to the selected component.
